name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and feet hip width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs, and brace your core.
Push the floor away, keeping your back flat, until you stand tall.
Hinge back and lower the bar down your legs to the floor.
cue: Brace, flat back, push the floor away
mistakes: Rounding the lower back off the floor.
Letting the bar drift away from your legs.
